narrative.coaching_note: El cambio más importante es que usted se lave las manos con agua y jabón en vez de usar el sanitizer cuando hay Norovirus. Usted tocó bed rail A con bare hand a los 0.2 segundos y la contaminación pasó a esa mano. A los 6.1 segundos esa contaminación pasó de bare hand a call button. A los 10.1 segundos pasó de bare hand a resident A. Usted usó sanitizer bottle a los 10.1 segundos y se frotó por 29.9 segundos, pero el alcohol rub no elimina Norovirus, solo el lavado con agua y jabón lo elimina. Por eso bare hand siguió contaminada y hubo más contactos con resident A a los 13.5 segundos y a los 40 segundos. La próxima vez lávese con agua y jabón por 40 segundos completos después de tocar bed rail A.
narrative.audit_summary: Analysis for Norovirus with source bed rail A. Transfers: bed rail A to bare hand at 0.2 seconds, bare hand to call button at 6.1 seconds, bare hand to resident A at 10.1 seconds, with further resident A exposures at 13.5 and 40 seconds. No WHO Five Moments opportunities were identified (0 met / 0 opportunities for Moments 1,2,4,5 and overall), so no moments missed. Hygiene event at 10.1 seconds with alcohol rub for 29.9 seconds met WHO duration but was not effective against Norovirus; soap and water wash would be effective. No glove use issues were identified. Contaminated at end: bare hand, gloved hand, bed rail A, call button, resident A. Disinfect resident A's bedside zone (linen and surfaces), bed rail A, and call button with EPA List G registered disinfectant.
narrative.top_fix: The clip showed no missed moments.
